notes.title: News From The Unfettered
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

With the first bi-weekly review of the new year, we continue to share with you the progress of The Unfettered game development process without interruption. We hope you now know how valuable the community's suggestions and requests are to The Unfettered team. Please don't forget to give us feedback via our social media after you read our articles, where we brought you the progress of the process.

The Unfettered continues to be developed in line with the wishes and expectations of the community.

First and foremost, all aspects of our game development processes continue at full speed, we share the most important points with you in our articles - we do not want to tire you by keeping them too long. The character selection screen that will allow players to create multiple builds of their characters has begun to be integrated; the UI has been developed and integrated for the "New Game" section.

In addition, work has begun on Pixie Skills. Pixie is a companion in the form of a glowing sphere which has its own skills to help the main character. The development of skill plans and matrices, which will have a great impact on the game, such as expanding the total health and mana bar value to be integrated, has been completed. These skills were coded and transferred to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/42a1c9de3276e432ba170f976e1245b511496cd3.jpg[/img]

It is an undeniable fact that the variety of mobs in action-RPG games like The Unfettered saves the game from being boring and repetitive. Efforts to increase mob variety in the game continue with the integration of diseased enemies into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/8dbe3c8892f907fac41b272338b5fa7667feef1a.jpg[/img]

As we mentioned in our previous article, one of the most crucial aspects influencing players' enjoyment of action-RPG games is the "intelligence" of the enemies they will encounter. To further improve this factor and provide a better gaming experience for our players, the reaction time of enemies when they spot the player has been re-tuned and synchronized.

Furthermore, while various animation developments are carried out for different conditions, it is highly unpleasant for gamers to face animation conflicts when these different situations occur at the same time. 
This problem has been solved by making modifications to prevent the created animations from overlapping. Another animation update was an improvement in the animation of the breakable walls falling down, which allow players to leave the current area and move to a new area or map. Also, the camera shaking effect while walls collapse has been integrated into the game.

Note: Steam allows gifs to be under 5MB.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/06fdf72347ae6fe02de6d2875cdcc26fa0905502.gif[/img]

Development of The Unfettered is in full swing into the new year for its demo release. Please do not forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist to be notified when it's released.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2156330/The_Unfettered/

You can interact with the community and learn about other benefits of being a member of The Unfettered community by joining our Discord server.

discord.gg/theunfettered

Thank you for your support.

Team

notes.title: News From The Unfettered
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

As The Unfettered team, it is very important for us to keep our players informed about the development process of the game. We want to show our players what a transparent team we are and enable them to imagine what kind of game they will face with the release of the early access version. Furthermore, the suggestions made by the players are extremely valuable to us. We hope that by publishing these biweekly reviews, we will be able to show where we are in the process and allow our players to make suggestions about the relevant process, so they can actively participate in the game-development process of The Unfettered. So, we are here with another bi-weekly review of The Unfettered.

To begin with, every part of the development is proceeding at full speed for the early access release. Gameplay and effects are very important in action RPG games. Players want to visually confirm the result of every move they make with strong effects, and they take pleasure in that. In order to provide this to our players, the [b]disintegration effect[/b] has been developed on defeated enemies, which is the effect you will encounter most in the game - To save Ashtanna, you will need to defeat many enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/b9d609d938d5a9498ab03838b8834911e7077582.gif[/img]

One of the most crucial aspects influencing players' enjoyment of action-RPG games is the "intelligence" of the enemies they will encounter. Artificial intelligence (AI) is programming that allows specific characters in a game, like non-player characters (NPCs) and enemies, to act as though they were directed by a person or owned their own minds. Nobody enjoys defeating an enemy who is only running on the pole. To achieve this and provide a better gaming experience for our players, improvements have been made to the AI of the enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/a58b8c8db7ad49d0035bffe40dd4e6abc4789e6a.gif[/img]

Every player wants their gaming character to be unique and compatible with their own playing style. This is accomplished by determining and building unique skill combinations for each character. The "Skill Tree" is being created and developed in The Unfettered in order to provide this diversity. Players will be able to play with characters who are more oriented to their own games once development is completed. The main character in the game will have active and passive skills that can be determined by the player.

The character's interaction with the environment and objects is a fundamental component in RPG games. The animations of lootable objects have been improved, increasing the realism of the game and helping the user better channel into it. In RPG games, looting has a direct impact on gameplay. At this point, metrics such as the luck factor in looted objects should be precisely determined in order to provide the optimum gaming experience. In the last two weeks, significant progress has been made on loot animation and the looting luck factor.

[b]The Unfettered is currently in full development for its early access release. Remember to add the game to your Steam wishlist to be notified when it's released.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2156330/The_Unfettered/

Joining our Discord server allows you to interact with the community and learn about the additional benefits of being a part of The Unfettered community.

discord.gg/theunfettered

Thanks a lot for your support.

Team

notes.title: News From The Unfettered
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

As we enter December, the last month of 2022, we’re here with our bi-weekly review to inform those who are curious about the development process of The Unfettered.
Development of The Unfettered, which is a both fun and challenging process, is in full swing in all aspects including developments and improvements based on feedback from our testers, for its early access release.

As you know The Unfettered is an upcoming action role-playing game (RPG). An essential feature of RPG games is the character's variety of interactions with the environment and objects. Increasing the realism of the game and allowing the player to better channel into the game, the number of these interactable objects (like opening the door by pulling the door mechanism) has been increased in The Unfettered and interaction customization parameters have been added on the developer panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/644d3ae56d4486778790f5b0e60b336b28728be3.jpg[/img]

Thereafter, breakable walls have been developed that allow players to leave the current area and move to a new area/map and can be opened/closed based on damage or multifunctional situations such as interactions with NPCs' or sitting on a savepoints. Then these breakable walls were integrated into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/072518c484038240ab83a60c43532fa5cdd71d94.jpg[/img]

In order to improve the saving system, existing problems on saving have been fixed and the system has been rewritten for all situations that are requested to be saved by making a distinction between runtime and Josha the savepoint.

Along with these, the new camera perspective, which provides a more systematic view of the game, has been developed and integrated into the game. Especially in RPG games, players have variable camera perspective preferences due to the differences in playing game  habits. The Unfettered has integrated this new camera perspective to improve the gameplay quality and meet the different desires of the players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/9b10877e71cc2ebecde2064926b8fbb935fb7085.jpg[/img]

Another of the improvements made is on "frames per second (FPS)". FPS, which is a term used to describe how smooth something like a video or a video game plays, is deemed important, especially action games. Players, of course, want the game to be played smoothly especially during the fights. In order to achieve this, FPS optimizations were made in The Unfettered.
Development of The Unfettered is in full swing in all aspects for its early access release. Don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist to be notified when it's released.

You can interact with the community and learn about other benefits of being a member of The Unfettered community by joining our [url=discord.gg/theunfettered]Discord [/url]server.

Thanks a lot for your support.

Team

notes.title: News From The Unfettered
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've taken the decision to review our activities during the first [b]two weeks of November[/b]. By creating our Steam store page, this will be our first post. We have already published a few detailed updates, but we now intend to do that every two weeks to keep you informed about the game.

First of all, each aspect of development is moving forward at full speed. We aimed to achieve this through changing the game's main menu's background in order to design a scene with appropriate visuals, we added the main character to a separate level in Unreal Engine. However, we gave up on this idea as it caused problems in terms of optimization in the game. Instead, a cinematic scene edited by our team appears on the loop as a video. And after that, when “New Game” is selected, the story trailer video, which we shared on social media before, as an introduction to the story of the game, comes into play.

Thereafter, we made some UI-related adjustments. The UIs of our inventory system, which we have already completed the development and implementation of, have been updated. The overall graphic design of the inventory screen was made from scratch. We wanted to capture a complete view by adding the items and potions we have. The positions of the items and potions in the inventory were determined, and the ready-made ones were integrated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/e65b85aef1250ad82175cd129a6b9d998cfb37c3.png[/img]

In order to follow the quest and story flow in the game, pieces of papers (journals) were developed and added into the narrative. Their in-game UI designs have been edited and enhanced. The quest system followed by journals was developed and implemented. In addition to these, again related to the UI, the place names in the game's world were adapted to the game and when those areas were entered, they were triggered and made on the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/b3eb5c5256cd1817ee6e3bba6b6171407718a6b3.jpg[/img]

Along with these, progress continues on the coding side as well. The mechanics and infrastructure of the puzzles we will add to the game have been developed and coded. The dialogue system was started to be implemented in the game by adding interactable characters(NPCs) and their dialogs.

Improved the mechanics of dropped items from killed enemies. The characteristics of these items, which are acquired from the game, to add features to the character and interact with the inventory system have been developed. The craft mechanic, which allows some items to be combined to create another item, has been developed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43093958/e8cec0917afcfd2a7b4fdbf0e1fa80e67415bb7d.jpg[/img]

We continue to develop the game at full throttle to release it as early access, and we look forward to it. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to be notified when the game is published. 

By joining our [url=https://discord.gg/theunfettered]Discord [/url]channel, you can socialize with the community and discover other privileges of being from The Unfettered community.

Thanks a lot for your support.

Team
